title: ConDR: Conservative Reachability through Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Subsolutions
abstract: arXiv:2611.06802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) Reachability identifies the unsafe states of a dynamical system from which it can be forced into failure under worst-case disturbance. However, classical grid-based solvers scale exponentially with state dimension. DeepReach improves scalability by replacing the grid with a neural value function trained on the HJ-Isaacs (HJI) variational inequality (VI), but penalizes both sides of the residual equally. This allows the learned value to lie above the true one and unsafe states to be misclassified as safe. We propose Conservative DeepReach (ConDR) which aims to learn a subsolution of the HJI VI such that the learned unsafe set contains the true one. ConDR enforces the obstacle branch and terminal condition by construction, pushes the HJI residual to a safety margin $\epsilon$ below zero with a one-sided loss, and prevents the degenerate solution of classifying everything as unsafe. translated_title: ConDR：基于神经网络汉密尔顿-雅可比下解的保守可达性分析
translated_abstract: 汉密尔顿-雅可比（HJ）可达性分析用于识别动力系统中的不安全状态，即在最坏情况扰动下系统可能被强制进入失败的那些状态。然而，经典的基于网格的求解器随状态维数呈指数级扩展。DeepReach 通过用基于 HJ-Isaacs（HJI）变分不等式（VI）训练的神经值函数取代网格来提升可扩展性，但它对残差的两侧施加同等的惩罚。这导致学到的值可能高于真实值，从而使不安全状态被错误地分类为安全。我们提出保守 DeepReach（ConDR），旨在学习 HJI 变分不等式的一个下解，使得学到的危险集包含真实的危险集。ConDR 通过构造方式强制执行障碍分支和终端条件，利用单边损失将 HJI 残差推至低于零的 $\epsilon$ 安全裕度，并防止将所有状态都判为不安全的退化解。我们证明了……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 ConDR 方法，通过单边损失和学习 HJI 变分不等式的下解来保证神经网络估计的危险集保守地包含真实危险集，同时避免退化解，实现了高维系统中安全可靠的可达性分析。
en_tdlr: ConDR learns a subsolution of the HJI variational inequality using a one-sided loss and constructive constraints, guaranteeing that the learned unsafe set conservatively contains the true one while avoiding degenerate solutions, thus enabling safe and scalable reachability analysis in high-dimensional systems.
